# Engine-fired notifications — the keys we can never count

**Generated by `python tools/message_catalog.py --markdown`. Do not hand-edit.**

103 of 468 vanilla notification keys have **no `post_notification` call site anywhere** in `common/` or `events/`. The engine posts them directly, so there is nothing to hook and no way to instrument them. Confirmed by exhaustive scan of the installed game, recomputed on every run of the tool rather than quoted from a doc.

**Engine-fired means uncountable, not uncontrollable.** `notification_type` still applies to every key here, so the mod and the hand-tuning recommendations both work on them. Only the census cannot count them — which is why every published figure is a lower bound.

Text shown is the localized title (or the description where the title is almost all substitution). `<>` marks a dynamic part that only resolves in-engine.
